name: Terrarium 100x50x50
label: Large terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 100x50x50 cm. Volume: 250.0 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: A length of 100 cm, a width of 50 cm and a height of 50 cm give 250 liters and 5000 cm² of floor. Among our terrariums one meter long, this one has the widest floor. That width is what matters most to an adult bearded dragon, because with half a meter of depth it turns and runs without hitting the glass.

Set up the warm end under a spot lamp on the left or right side, and leave the opposite 50 to 60 cm cooler, with a hide. Half a meter of height allows a thicker layer of substrate for tortoises and a skink that like to dig. A ball python gets room for a branch placed low above the floor.

Without a 3D background the interior stays completely free, and cover on three sides comes from the outer film in the pattern you choose. The version with a background exists as the 100x50x50 +3D. For a longer terrarium, look at the 120x40x50 or send us your own dimensions. A build to order takes 7 to 14 days, and delivery is by courier to your address.
